summary: A static, light pricing page (#f4f4f6 ground, near-black type) at 1244x996 that does not move at all across the 3s: frame diffs at 0.2→1.2s, 0.5→2.5s and 1.5→2s show no change. A thin top nav (y≈0–49, hairline divider below) carries the Lemni mark and wordmark at left (x≈82), grey links Docs / Blog / Company / Community ↗ spaced across the middle, a black "Pricing" (current page) and a black "Continue" with a black circled right arrow at right. Centred below: a two-line tight-tracked grotesk headline "Expect more / and pay less" (~76px cap-to-cap lines, x≈428–818, y≈152–292), then a three-line centred 18px paragraph whose last sentence "Receive 50% off on your first year." is semibold. The lower half is a centred pricing card (x≈413–831, y≈548–963, ~16px radius, off-white fill slightly lighter than the page, soft diffuse shadow, no hard border) laid over a dense halo of glossy 3D brand icons (phone, OpenAI knot, Salesforce cloud, Shopify bag, HubSpot sprocket, Twilio, play button, folder, Gmail, green stacked layers, Notion, manuals, purple beads, star) that peek out above and to both sides and are cropped by the frame bottom. The card holds a grey struck-through "$196", a large black "$98", a small "/Month", a hairline divider, three rows of grey off-state toggles with grey labels, a full-width black pill "Try For Free" button, and two lines of small grey footnote.

criteria.check: Nothing moves: the whole frame at 0.5s is identical to the frame at 2.5s (no entrance, no float, no hover).
The 3D icons around the card do not float or drift: their positions at 1.5s match those at 2s exactly.
Page background is a flat very light cool grey (~#f4f4f6), not pure white and not a gradient.
A 1px light grey hairline spans the full width just under the nav at y≈49.
A small logo mark of overlapping rounded diamond shapes shading grey to black sits left of the word 'Lemni' at x≈82–114, y≈14–36.
Wordmark reads exactly 'Lemni' in black, medium weight, ~17px.
Middle nav items read, left to right, 'Docs', 'Blog', 'Company', 'Community ↗' (small north-east arrow after Community).
Docs, Blog, Company and Community are mid grey, clearly lighter than the black 'Pricing'.
'Pricing' in black sits at x≈918–966, vertically centred at y≈24.
'Continue' is black text followed by a ~18px solid black circle containing a white right-pointing arrow, ending at x≈1162.
Headline reads exactly 'Expect more' on line 1 and 'and pay less' on line 2.
Headline is black regular-weight (not bold) sans with tight negative tracking, cap height ~55px, lines ~70px apart.
Headline is horizontally centred on the frame (x≈428–818) with its top at y≈152.
Paragraph reads 'We don’t charge per seat. Delivering a premium / customer experience shouldn’t come with a premium / price tag. Receive 50% off on your first year.' in three centred lines.
Only 'Receive 50% off on your first year.' is semibold black; the rest is regular dark grey ~18px.
Card is centred horizontally, spanning x≈413–831 and y≈548–963 (≈418×415).
Card corners are rounded ~16px.
Card edge is a soft diffuse shadow over the icons, with no hard stroke/outline line.
Card fill is an opaque off-white (near #f6f6f7), not translucent or frosted: icons behind it are fully hidden, not blurred through.
'$196' appears in light grey with a horizontal strike line through its middle.
'$98' is black, same ~44px size as '$196', immediately to its right at x≈560.
'/Month' in small (~16px) black text sits right of '$98', bottom-aligned with the price baseline.
A thin light grey hairline spans x≈453–792 at y≈654 between price and feature list.
Exactly 3 feature rows, each a toggle followed by a label, spaced ~44px apart (y≈692, 736, 780).
Labels read 'Unlimited knowledge', 'Unlimited phone agents', '10+ Workplace members' top to bottom, in mid grey ~16px.
Each toggle is a small ~28×18 pill in OFF state: very light grey track with a white knob on the left, no colour accent.
Button spans x≈453–792, y≈817–857, the same width as the divider.
Button is solid black with fully rounded (pill) ends.
Button label reads 'Try For Free' in white medium ~16px, centred.
Footnote reads '*Interaction refers to each time your agent is asked to take / action. For example, it receives an email, call, or webhook.' in two centred lines.
Footnote is small (~13px) mid grey, lighter than the feature labels' darkness is not exceeded (no black).
A dense cluster of colourful 3D icons surrounds the card on top, left and right, peeking ~100px above the card top (from y≈443) and running off the bottom frame edge.
Icons are glossy rendered 3D objects with soft highlights and shading (as the clip's own artwork), not flat vector logos.
Above the card, left to right: green phone handset, black OpenAI knot, blue Salesforce-style cloud, green Shopify bag, orange HubSpot sprocket.
Left of the card: pink Twilio-style ring with 4 dots, pink-purple sphere with a white play triangle, light blue folder, orange 'Application Manual' booklets, purple beads.
Right of the card: Gmail-style red/yellow/green/blue shape, stacked lime-green layers, a black-and-white Notion 'N' cube, pink looping cable below.
The icons sit behind the card: the card overlaps and hides their inner parts (e.g. OpenAI knot and cloud are cut by the card's top edge at y≈548).
